Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- New: Bone Align (sidebar, under Live Offset). Pick a body part for yourself and your partner (penis, vagina, anus, left/right buttock, mouth, left/right hand, left/right fingers) and press Align. It resyncs emotes, watches both parts for a moment, then moves you so they meet at the animation's contact point. Works with your paired partner or any targeted player, and needs no update on their side.
- Align leaves a little room between the parts (Gap slider, default 0.02y) so they meet instead of fusing.
- Match facing (on by default): Align also turns you so the two parts face each other, e.g. when one of you starts facing the wrong way. It only turns, never tilts, and skips parts pointing mostly up or down.
- If both paired partners press Align at once, only one of you moves. The alignment is temporary: Reset or a new pose clears it, and it's never saved into presets.
- New /posekit bones command: logs your and your target's bone names to /xllog.
